wheat.source: FAO-56 typical values (Kc ini 0.3, mid 1.15, end 0.25; p 0.55). Stage lengths and root depth are typical guesses. PLACEHOLDER: confirm with your state agricultural university / KVK before real use.

sugarcane.source: FAO crop information (Kc mid 1.25, p 0.65) and FAO-56 (Kc ini 0.4, Kc end ~0.75). Stage lengths and root depth are typical guesses for spring-planted plant cane in north India (~12 months). PLACEHOLDER: confirm with UP Cane Research Council / local KVK.
